title: Eviction Notice Requirements
content: A landlord must provide written notice before eviction. The notice period depends on local tenancy laws. Eviction without court order may be illegal.

title: Security Deposit Refund
content: A landlord must return the security deposit within the legally prescribed time after termination of tenancy. Deductions must be documented.

title: Termination Rights
content: An employee has the right to receive notice before termination unless terminated for misconduct. Severance pay may apply.
